layout: app/modules/document_center/ — 3-pane tenant UI (left vault list, center Semptify viewer, right overlays/checklist). Reads documents and real overlays from the user's cloud vault; persists review state and document type in the vault index; creates DocumentShare rows for sharing.

input_audit.note: Discovered by scanning the authenticated user's cloud vault; no PII stored in PostgreSQL.
Selected by the tenant from the 8 allowed document types, or corrected after upload.
Tenant confirms or corrects each extracted field; persisted as structured overlay data.
Tenant enters recipient and scope when they choose to share a document.

preview_state: Tenant sees the selected document rendered in the Semptify viewer with current overlay progress, document type dropdown, and status selector before saving any review state.
review_state: Tenant sees the updated verification status (new/review/verified/mismatched), the saved field confirmation state, and the current feature-unlock progress after each review save.
output_how: FastAPI endpoints return JSON to drive the 3-pane template; the main page is served by GET /dc (page_router + dedicated route). Sharing creates a DocumentShare row and returns a token.
output_where: app/templates/pages/document_center.html in the browser; JSON from /api/dc/* endpoints; DocumentShare row for shared access.
output_why: Gives the tenant a single, calm place to review, verify, annotate, and share their housing documents with full transparency and control over what Semptify extracts.
process_description: Lists the tenant's vault documents, renders the selected file in the Semptify viewer, fetches real OCR overlays from cloud storage, lets the tenant confirm or correct extracted fields, tracks per-document-type required fields, computes verification status, unlocks downstream features as verified metadata accumulates, and supports scoped document sharing.
process_context: Runs whenever a tenant visits /dc or calls a /api/dc/* endpoint; requires an authenticated user with valid cloud storage.

narrative_events.context_clause: because the tenant opened it in the Document Center viewer
after the OCR pipeline processed the document
when the document type has requirements the OCR did not satisfy
because the tenant selected the correct type from the dropdown
after the tenant confirmed or corrected the extracted fields
when the tenant corrected more fields than they confirmed
because the tenant chose to share the document with a recipient
while the document is still being processed in the background
